contribution_boundary: Representative exact section preservation and report-only gardening execute through real CLI and sealed installed baseline. Retirement/recovery applications only use disposable Git. Final original-case and independent closure remain S08.

implementation.preservation: Every original byte, including preamble/fences, maps to revision/path/line/hash-bound sections. Retained original or attributed exact destination is required. Summary/omission, fabricated locator, source/destination/evidence drift and origin mismatch cannot be complete.
implementation.gardening: Normal incremental/apply are report-only. User backups/worktrees/tracked Markdown remain gated. Filename/untracked status are not deletion authority. Unrelated dirty paths and broad parent directories cannot expand the Work. Full scan requires explicit high-risk repository_gardening Work; NUL reads and incomplete reference scans fail closed.
implementation.retirement: Read-only proposal binds all tracked/untracked/ignored bytes, HEAD/index, seven reference assessments, exact preservation, retention and evidence. Unknown external/dynamic/build/test/package/config assessment or known reverse reference is HOLD.
implementation.authority: No destructive CLI or approval JSON interpreter. Internal application requires an existing trusted authority callback and verifier callback; tests supply exact synthetic adapters. Authorization binds plan, targets, root identity and external quarantine path.
implementation.recovery: Verified source/index backups and prepared journal precede mutation. Stages recheck scope/HEAD/content/references. Git index compare/replace uses its lock and plan-bound before/after hashes. Failure and actual killed-process recovery preserve evidence; foreign files/index/symlinks and corrupt backups are rejected. Tombstone follows passing re-verification.
implementation.read_only_git: A real fsmonitor side-effect was reproduced. Git reads and alternate-index preparation now disable fsmonitor/hooks. Planning and normal garden pass the side-effect canary.
implementation.packaging: Actual empty-target sealed installation executes preservation and report-only gardening; root/shared payload scripts match and generic guides retain separate repository ownership.
